about: The file big.txt in this folder holds about 41,000 characters. Save it as a note with the notes MCP server's save_note tool, title "big", body the whole text of big.txt. The arguments are large: write only the arguments object ({"title": ..., "body": ...}) to a JSON file under /tmp, then call use_tool with tool_name set to the tool and tool_input_file set to that file, as your use_tool instructions describe. Then reply with what the tool answered. A large MCP call's arguments passed through a file: the model writes only the arguments to a JSON file and calls use_tool with the tool's name and that file, which Grok reads, reporting the call it ran inline.
